tasks.analysis: Human cognition refers to the mental processes involved in acquiring, processing, storing, and using knowledge. These include the ways that people interpret sensory signals (perception), how we store and retrieve information (memory), how language is produced (speech), and how humans analyze and solve problems. Researchers study cognitive functions to uncover how the brain processes information and how these processes influence behavior. Insights from cognitive science can improve educational methods and help develop interventions for cognitive disorders. 人类认知指的是获取、加工、存储和运用知识所涉及的一系列心理过程。这包括人们对感官信号的解读方式（知觉）、信息的存储与提取方式（记忆）、语言的产生方式（言语），以及人类分析和解决问题的方式。研究者通过探究认知功能，来揭示大脑如何处理信息，以及这些过程如何影响行为。认知科学的研究成果能够优化教育方法，并有助于为认知障碍制定干预方案。
